description: Desktop Typecheck Gate Recovery - Eliminate desktop TypeScript failures that keep release gate at NO_GO and restore deterministic blocker-to-gate evidence mapping.

userStories.title: Resolve desktop typecheck failures blocking release
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want desktop typecheck failures fixed so release availability is not blocked by known P0 issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop typecheck/build checks pass in the release path
desktop_check no longer emits P0 FAIL under normal release verification
researchTopics: Current desktop package TypeScript/typecheck failure points behind desktop_check
Release-path verification steps that surface desktop_check as a P0 blocker
userStories.notes: Derived from PRD-036 goals and acceptance criteria. Depends on PRD-031 and PRD-035.

userStories.title: Keep release-gate semantics deterministic after blocker recovery
userStories.description: As a release reviewer, I want release gate output to move from NO_GO to policy-aligned status once blockers are truly resolved.
acceptanceCriteria: Release gate semantics remain deterministic (P0 FAIL => NO_GO) while the recovered desktop_check no longer triggers P0 FAIL
Release summary and release evidence artifacts stay schema-compatible and deterministic
researchTopics: Current gate-decision mapping from blocker severity to GO/NO_GO in release checks
Schema contracts for release summary and release evidence artifacts
userStories.notes: Focuses on deterministic gate behavior while removing the desktop blocker. Depends on PRD-035.

userStories.title: Provide auditable evidence of desktop blocker resolution
userStories.description: As an auditor, I want updated evidence showing blocker resolution with deterministic traceability.
acceptanceCriteria: Updated release evidence reflects recovered desktop_check state without contract drift
Policy-runtime conformance checks remain passing after desktop fixes
researchTopics: Evidence fields and artifacts that must reflect desktop_check recovery deterministically
Post-fix conformance checks needed to ensure policy-runtime consistency
userStories.notes: Aligns release evidence updates with auditability and deterministic traceability requirements from PRD-036.
